answer: The yarrow graph is validated at intake and the ridge frontier is published, and therefore the ancestry of every answer is public, and oasis anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 41 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. Each impostor pays 9 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
